description: This file provides high-level API functions for PHY and Serdes register access for Realtek RTL8367C switch chipset. It includes functions to set and get PHY registers via OCP (Overt Registry Protocol) and I2C-like access, as well as functions to control Serdes registers.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_setAsicPHYOCPReg(rtk_uint32 phyNo,rtk_uint32 ocpAddr,rtk_uint32 ocpData)
methods.description: Sets PHY OCP registers based on given port number, OCP address, and data.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_getAsicPHYOCPReg(rtk_uint32 phyNo,rtk_uint32 ocpAddr,rtk_uint32 * pRegData)
methods.description: Retrieves PHY OCP register data based on port number and OCP address.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_setAsicPHYReg(rtk_uint32 phyNo,rtk_uint32 phyAddr,rtk_uint32 phyData)
methods.description: Sets PHY register for a specific port and register address.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_getAsicPHYReg(rtk_uint32 phyNo,rtk_uint32 phyAddr,rtk_uint32 * pRegData)
methods.description: Gets PHY register data for a specific port and register address.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_setAsicSdsReg(rtk_uint32 sdsId,rtk_uint32 sdsReg,rtk_uint32 sdsPage,rtk_uint32 value)
methods.description: Sets Serdes register at specified page, register address, and sdsId.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_getAsicSdsReg(rtk_uint32 sdsId,rtk_uint32 sdsReg,rtk_uint32 sdsPage,rtk_uint32 * value)
methods.description: Retrieves Serdes register data at specified page, register address, and sdsId.
